headline: Affordable Robotic & Automation files AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: Affordable Robotic & Automation Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The filing completes the mandatory post-AGM compliance required for listed companies on the stock exchanges. Retail shareholders can review the passed resolutions on the exchange portals. This is standard corporate governance procedure with no immediate impact on share price.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate financial impact.

headline: Affordable Robotic & Automation Limited submits AGM proceedings
hook: Routine shareholder meeting concluded at Affordable Robotic
summary: Affordable Robotic & Automation Limited has submitted the official proceedings of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the exchange. This is a routine compliance filing for listed companies. Such disclosures do not typically carry immediate financial impact or strategic shifts. Indian retail investors holding the stock should note the completion of statutory obligations.
why_it_matters: Compliance filing with no immediate financial impact
